text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Maruzen-sama, please watch closely~.
I shall show you the fruits of my studies~!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Mhm-mhm, that's the spirit!
All that's left is to take on the challenge for your "solo journey"!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Yes~. Well then—here I go!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Maruzen-sama~! The discount tickets I was looking into
ended their sale last week~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
It cannot be helped, I suppose.
Let us cancel today's departure and go another day—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Oh, but look!
It looks like they're running another campaign.
Wouldn't this one be a better deal for a round trip?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
My, as expected of Maruzen-sama~. You truly are
accustomed to "solo travel," aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Umm...
There are so many kinds of ekiben.
My, which one should I choose~—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
It really is hard to decide~
Fancy Italian cuisine, or a mature Japanese set meal—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Rrrr-ring—)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
There were so many wonderful boxed lunches~.
Next time, I shall strive to buy one before departure.

text_block_list.name: Train Cart Vendor
text_block_list.text:
These boxed lunches are limited to 10 per day
for in-train sales! Would you care for one?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Yes please! Right here~!
...Fufu♪ Missing out on it earlier let me snag one after all!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
! ...I see~.
That is certainly true.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Oh, my. To think it would be temporarily closed today~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Mishaps like this are simply part of traveling, aren't they?
However—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Um, let's see—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Ah! Look at that, Lady Maruzen~!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Mmm~~, what a view! Aren't we so lucky to have found such a wonderful spot!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Yes. It's all thanks to following Lady Maruzen's example
and searching for something even more wonderful.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"The only one who can do that is myself.
Maruzen-sama was the one who taught me that."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
You truly are a master of "solo travel,"
Maruzen-sama~

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's not true at all.
I was completely useless at first too, you know—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Even on our first drive, I couldn't figure out the GPS
and got totally lost.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Before I knew it, I ended up somewhere completely different from my destination. But—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
The night view I saw there was
sooo, sooo pretty!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Not a soul around...
A luxurious moment having the night view all to myself—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I learned that depending on your mindset,
even failures can become good memories.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
That's why I enjoy any mistake I make. I really think that's
the secret to "solo travel"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, I saw Maruzensky and Mejiro Bright chatting happily together.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I've planned out my "solo trip," so I wanted to thank you~. Thanks to you, Maruzen-sama, I feel confident enough to set off on my journey~.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Fufu, I hope it turns out to be a wonderful trip!
choice_data_list: Now you've got me wanting to go on a trip too...

As expected, you're being a great senior!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Isn't it great! 'Solo travel' has a special kind of fun you can't experience anywhere else!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Be sure to enjoy your own unique view!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, a trendy big sis
needs to blast out in front, after all!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, now I feel like traveling too.
Maybe I should plan a solo trip♪
